<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a series of peaks spaced ~1 Da with relative intensities (100 → 20 → 2 → 0.12 → …) that match the binomial distribution expected for 13C in a molecule containing about 18 carbon atoms. No distinct M+2 pattern characteristic of Cl, Br, or S is present, and other elements have much lower natural isotope abundances that would not produce the observed clear pattern. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
